Frequently asked questions

How many Data Scientist jobs are open in the United States?

Fortune Jobs AI lists 1,672 open Data Scientist jobs in the United States as of November 25, 2026.

How much do Data Scientist jobs in the United States pay?

The 25th–75th percentile of listed salary midpoints is $123,000–$184,087 a year, based on 366 listings where employers list pay. Listings without usable pay data are excluded; hourly and yearly pay are not mixed.

Which employers are hiring for Data Scientist jobs in the United States?

Employers in this catalogue include PwC (95 listings), Serco (48 listings), Coinbase (46 listings), Indeed (43 listings), and Guidehouse (42 listings).

Do any Data Scientist jobs in the United States mention visa sponsorship or OPT?

1 listing mentions visa sponsorship or OPT/CPT. A mention does not guarantee sponsorship or eligibility; confirm with the employer.

Are there entry-level Data Scientist jobs in the United States?

61 listings mention entry-level, new-grad, junior or graduate roles in the title or description. Review the original posting for its experience requirements.
